headline: NAS CROWNED A BMI ICON
body: Nas received BMI's highest honor at the 2026 R&B/Hip-Hop Awards in Los Angeles, recognizing three decades of elite songwriting and influence that reshaped hip-hop.
caption:
Nas received BMI's highest honor at the 2026 R&B/Hip-Hop Awards in Los Angeles, recognizing three decades of elite songwriting and influence that reshaped hip-hop.

Babyface presented the Icon Award after tributes from Evelyn “Champagne” King and Large Professor. BMI honored Nas for his prolific songwriting and lasting impact on hip-hop and beyond.

Sources: BMI and DancehallMag, Aug. 27–29, 2026. Original editorial illustration by RapWire 24/7.
